payment_method.description: How the purchase is paid: card (Stripe) or invoice

po_to_follow.description: Whether the purchase order number will be supplied later

status.description: Purchase status: pending (not yet spendable), paid (credited to available), or cancelled

stripe_payment_intent_id.description: Stripe PaymentIntent id for card purchases

accounting_provider.description: Accounting provider that created the invoice (xero/quickbooks)

xero_invoice_id.description: Legacy Xero invoice id (dual-written with accounting_invoice_id)

transaction_id.description: Linked training_fund_transaction ledger row id once credited

created_by.description: Member id of the admin who created the purchase

paid_at.description: When the purchase was confirmed paid and credited
